scripts.tauri:win:x64: rustup target add x86_64-pc-windows-gnu && tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu
scripts.tauri:win:x32: sh -lc 'set -a; . src-tauri/.env; set +a; mv src-tauri/rclone/rclone.exe src-tauri/rclone/rclone64.exe && mv src-tauri/rclone/rclone32.exe src-tauri/rclone/rclone.exe && (rustup target add i686-pc-windows-gnu && tauri build --target i686-pc-windows-gnu); status=$?; mv src-tauri/rclone/rclone.exe src-tauri/rclone/rclone32.exe && mv src-tauri/rclone/rclone64.exe src-tauri/rclone/rclone.exe; exit $status'
scripts.tauri:all: npm run tauri:win:x64 && npm run tauri:win:x32
scripts.tauri:build:all: npm run tauri:build:win:x64 && npm run tauri:build:win:x32
